reply.emotion: waiting at a busy corner on a hot afternoon, watching the traffic roll by
notes: In Mexico and many other Spanish-speaking countries, 'camión' is the standard everyday word for a public bus, while 'autobús' sounds much more formal.
Do not confuse it with 'coche' or 'carro', which mean a private car.

senses.definition: Vehículo grande de motor que transporta a muchos pasajeros por una ruta fija en la ciudad.

examples.text: Siempre tomo el camión para ir al centro.
examples.translation: I always take the bus to go downtown.
examples.emotion: rushing out the door in the morning, knowing the schedule well

senses.definition: Vehículo muy grande y pesado que sirve para transportar mercancías y carga pesada por la carretera.

examples.text: Un camión grande lleva cajas por la carretera.
examples.translation: A large truck carries boxes along the highway.
examples.emotion: watching heavy traffic pass by on a long road trip
